source_title: Variance Decomposition and Cryptocurrency Return Prediction
hypothesis: Cryptocurrencies with lower recent realized variance outperform higher-variance peers over the subsequent week.
mechanism: The source documents a negative cross-sectional relation between realized variance and subsequent cryptocurrency returns; a low-variance rank should therefore carry positive predictive information.
signal: Negative lagged sum of squared hourly log returns over the formation window.
universe: Point-in-time assets with 30 days exact hourly continuity; top 80 percent by lagged trailing 30-day mean close*volume; minimum 8 assets.
rebalance: Weekly Monday 00:00 UTC; signal uses only completed bars before execution at current open.
construction: Equal-weight long highest low-variance-signal tercile / short lowest tercile, 0.5 gross per side.
development_gate: canonical mean rank IC >= 0.02, HAC p < 0.05, positive long-minus-short subsequent-week return
limitations: Available panel has 19 curated Binance perpetuals rather than a complete survivorship-free exchange history.
